problem_type: Small Bucket Lot-Sizing with 1 Set-up per Period (SB-1, Con-NT model)

model_description.objective: Minimize total setup + startup + holding + backlogging costs

variables.x_ikt: Production of item i on machine k in period t (continuous >= 0)
variables.s_it: Stock of item i at end of period t (continuous >= 0)
variables.r_it: Backlog of item i at end of period t (continuous >= 0)
variables.y_ikt: 1 if machine k is set up for item i in period t (binary)
variables.z_ikt: 1 if machine k starts up for item i in period t (binary)

constraints.flow_balance: s_{i,t-1} - r_{i,t-1} + sum_k x_{ikt} = d_{it} + s_{it} - r_{it}  for all i,t
constraints.capacity_startup: x_{ikt} + sigma_k * z_{ikt} <= C_k * y_{ikt}  for all i,k,t
constraints.startup_definition: z_{ikt} >= y_{ikt} - y_{ik,t-1}  for all i,k,t
constraints.linking: y_{ik,t-1} + z_{ikt} + sum_{j!=i} (y_{jkt} - z_{jkt}) <= 1  for all i,k,t
